products.name: FiberFox Mini 3S Active V-Groov Clade Splicer Machine
products.description:
FiberFox Mini 3S Active V-Groove Clade Splicer Machine

The FiberFox Mini 3S Active V-Groov Clade Splicer Machine is an Active Alignment (DAA: Digitalized Active Alignment) splicer machine. The machine has an average loss of SM(0.03dB) / MM(0.02dB) / DS(0.05dB) / NZDS(0.05dB) with a splicing time of SM Mode: 8 Sec. It has 139 (Pre-set: 11 / User set-up: 128) splicing modes with an attenuation range of 0.1 ~ 20 dB. The fiber types that can be used in this machine are SM(ITU-T G652 & G.657)/ MM(ITU-T G.651) / DS(ITU-T G.653) / NZDS(ITU-T G.655) with a diameter coating of 100 to 3,000um. The average heating time is 18 seconds and there are 37 (Pre-set: 5 / User set-up: 32) heating modes that are available. The electrode life span is>3,500arcs. The machine can store up to 10,000/ 20,000 images. To detect the fiber, the machine uses a Dual CCD camera with LED emitting system and illuminates the area with an LED Spot light. The machine has a Color 4.3" LCD monitor, with Touch Screen (Tempered Glass) display that allows you to see all the functions and features. The battery used here is Li-ion 11.1V 3000mAh, 200 cycles (Splicing & Heating) with a power supply ability of AC 100-240V input or DC 12.6V 1.8A.

The FiberFox Mini 3S Active V-Groov Clade Splicer Machine provides you with 1 Year Warranty.
